english.title: Tamper with a lift / escalator / travelator / transit system / conveyor belt / jetty / apparatus at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[a lift]_

(C)_[a travelator]_
(D)_[a tracked transit system]_
(E)_[a conveyor belt]_
(F)_[an air jetty]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7(2) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
